1.explanation: The root cause of negative user timing marks is likely in how the timestamps for marks are calculated relative to navigationStart. In 'filterTrace' (in 'lighthouse-core/audits/user-timings.js'), user timing events have their startTime (and endTime/duration for measures) offset by the navigationStartTime (ut.startTime -= navigationStartTime). If a mark occurs before navigationStart, this calculation yields a negative value. The 'UserTimings' class orchestrates this audit and calls 'filterTrace', making both directly relevant. Fixing this requires filtering out or properly handling user timing marks that occur before navigationStart. Other files (like formatters or trace processing) do not handle the time math or filtering logic, so the bug is isolated to the filtering and audit logic in 'user-timings.js'.
